:root [data-ui-dlg] .ptd-dh > h2.dlg-title.ptd-h { font: 800 25px/1.2 var(--nb-font-head); letter-spacing: -0.02em; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--nb-ink); }
.ptd-prev-p { background: color-mix(in srgb,var(--nb-veil-c) 75%,transparent); border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb,var(--nb-ink) 20%,transparent); }
.ptd-note { background: color-mix(in srgb,var(--nb-ink) 4%,transparent); border: 1.5px dashed color-mix(in srgb,var(--nb-ink) 18%,transparent); }
